BACKGROUND MUSIC
“Master of the Feast” — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Source: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1400019
Audio source: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/mp3-royaltyfree/Master%20of%20the%20Feast.mp3
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original recording retained. Original playing volume restored. Runtime
crossfades before the quiet outro tail, with a 220.7-second transition endpoint.

SOUND EFFECTS
Kenney Impact Sounds — Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The 13 original game samples are retained. 21 additional short Foley variants
are extracted from the same licensed pack: wood, plate, glass, metal, generic,
punch and plank recordings, three versions each. Changes: onset trim,
high-pass/EQ, tiny fade-in, short fade-out and peak normalization.
MIX-PROVENANCE.json records every original filename, SHA-256 and filter.
The runtime layers recordings with round-robin variants, small pitch changes,
priority/polyphony limits, separate SFX compression and a final bus limiter.
No oscillator sound effects or microphone recordings are used.

VISUALS
All visual artwork in this game is original procedural Canvas artwork.
No image-generation service or extracted game sprites were used.
Visual/gameplay reference: Rakuworld by SETO. This is an independent browser
prototype, not an official Rakuworld release.
